use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant (SYS-16) for drafting, summarizing, meeting recaps, and file search across the holding company and all four subsidiaries
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite provider's enterprise generative AI add-on (vendor-hosted large language model in the group tenant); no custom model or fine-tuning
data_categories: Prompts and anything the user can open in SYS-03: email, chat, 96 collaboration sites, internal meetings; includes Restricted data (Finance customer information, plan PHI, employee SSNs, vendor bank details, deal information)
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: employees, borrowers, plan members, customers, and vendors whose data it can surface or who receive drafted messages)
consequential_decision_category: None (use in Employment or Credit decisions is prohibited by POL-05 4.9 and would re-tier to High)
human_in_the_loop: User reviews every output before use; second reviewer for borrower replies; HR reviews AI-drafted job postings; no agent actions or connectors
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1)(ii), (c)(2), (e)(1), (f), (g) (Finance); N55-R06 (45 CFR 164.308(a)(4)) for plan PHI it can reach; Fla. Stat. 501.171; Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) for meeting transcription; FTC Act Section 5
status: In production (180 users since 2026-05-04); approved with 6 conditions 2026-09-22; no new users until conditions are met

use_case: Finance credit scorecard: the loan origination vendor's machine-learning score automatically declines applications below a cutoff and approves applications under $5,000 above a second cutoff
business_owner: Finance President (business reviewer: Finance Compliance Officer)
vendor_or_model: Loan origination vendor's machine-learning scorecard feature in SYS-14 (vendor model; Finance sets the cutoffs)
data_categories: Application data, credit bureau attributes, income, age, payment history (customer information)
human_in_the_loop: Today: none for automated decisions (38% of applications decided without review). Required: underwriter review of every automated decline and every application within 20 points of a cutoff until validation is complete
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4(a); 1002.6(b)(1)-(2); 1002.9(a)(2), (b)(2)); 16 CFR 314.4(c)(4), (f) (Finance); FTC Act Section 5; bank partner participation agreement
status: In production since 2025-10; approved with conditions 2026-09-22; automated declines suspended from 2026-10-01 until reasons and validation are fixed

use_case: Applicant ranking in the recruiting software used by Supply and Home Services: scores applicants and automatically rejects those below a threshold
business_owner: VP of Human Resources (users: Supply and Home Services recruiters)
vendor_or_model: Recruiting software vendor's AI ranking feature (vendor model)
data_categories: Resumes, application answers, work history, location, voluntary EEO self-identification (kept separate)
human_in_the_loop: Today: none for rejected applicants (recruiters see only those above the threshold). Required: auto-reject off; a recruiter reviews every applicant who meets minimum qualifications
applicable_laws: Title VII (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); Age Discrimination in Employment Act; Americans with Disabilities Act; Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures (29 CFR 1607.4(D) four-fifths rule, used as a screening measure)
status: In production since 2026-01 (about 6,500 applicants in 2026); approved with conditions 2026-09-22; auto-reject turned off 2026-09-15

use_case: Invoice capture and coding in the ERP: reads supplier invoices and suggests general ledger coding
data_categories: Supplier invoices; vendor names and amounts (no personal information beyond sole-proprietor suppliers)
human_in_the_loop: Accounts payable staff approve every coded invoice; payments follow the normal approval and callback rules
applicable_laws: None specific; payment controls under POL-05 4.4

use_case: Home Services after-hours AI voice agent: answers calls, books appointments, and triages emergencies (gas smell, no cooling for vulnerable customers, water leaks) for escalation to the on-call manager
vendor_or_model: Voice agent vendor (speech recognition and large language model; vendor-hosted)
data_categories: Call audio and transcripts; names, addresses, phone numbers; descriptions of household conditions (including medical needs mentioned by callers)
human_in_the_loop: Today: the on-call manager reviews the overnight log each morning. Required: hard-coded live transfer to the on-call manager for emergency keywords; monthly scripted test calls
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) (all-party consent for recording; greeting discloses recording); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (transcripts hold personal information); FTC Act Section 5 (the agent must not misrepresent that callers are speaking with a person)
status: In production since 2026-03 (about 70 calls a night in summer); approved with conditions 2026-09-22; emergency escalation fix due 2026-11-30

use_case: Supply demand forecasting in the distribution system: suggests reorder quantities
data_categories: Item sales history; supplier lead times (no personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Purchasing staff approve every purchase order
